cohort: A single young female who had an uncomplicated C-section.
finding: This case report highlights the rare occurrence of Capnocytophaga sputigena causing severe intra-abdominal abscesses after C-section, emphasizing the importance of considering this unusual pathogen.
mod_finding: This case report highlights Capnocytophaga sputigena as a rare cause of post-C-section intra-abdominal infection.
